title: lobby_status
description: Lobby state snapshot sent by the plugin on player enter/leave/host change or on request

in_room.description: Whether the bot is currently in a Photon room

in_lobby.description: Whether the bot is in the Photon lobby (room list)

room_name.description: Name of the current Photon room

is_host.description: Whether this bot is the Photon master client

is_open.description: Whether the room is open for joining

is_visible.description: Whether the room is visible in the room list
